# PolyPop triggers

## Message from PolyPop

Runs when PolyPop sends Cuebot a message through its WebSocket plugin, for example when a button or trigger in PolyPop is pressed.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message types** | Only react to this kind of message, like "TRIGGER". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any kind. |
| **Names** | Only react to messages with this name (the name set on the PolyPop side). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any name. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%polypop.type%` | The kind of message, like TRIGGER |
| `%polypop.name%` | The name PolyPop gave the message |
| `%polypop.data%` | Extra information that came with it |
| `%polypop.sourceId%` | Which PolyPop plugin sent it |
| `%polypop.raw%` | The whole message exactly as received |

<small>Type id: `polypop.message`</small>

## Plugin connected

Runs when the PolyPop WebSocket plugin connects to Cuebot. Cuebot opens the door; PolyPop comes in.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%polypop.remote%` | Where the PolyPop plugin connected from |

<small>Type id: `polypop.connected`</small>

## Plugin disconnected

Runs when the last PolyPop plugin connection closes.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%polypop.remote%` | Where the PolyPop plugin connected from |
| `%reason%` | Why it closed |

<small>Type id: `polypop.disconnected`</small>
